ValidationRule.description: Business Team Cannot Change the Business Team result until Approver Escalate to Business.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Business_Approval_Result__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(cc_Credit_Approval_Result__c, 'Escalate to Business Team')), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Type , "Convert Credit Card Nature Application"), AND(ISPICKVAL( Type , "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card")) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Business team cannot change the Business team result until Approval Escalate to Business
